A '''furtive''' [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. [[Gender/Legends|He]] was associated with both [[Arden Telowe]] and [[Rayne]].

The Jawa visited the former's [[Desert Survey Office/Legends|Desert Survey Office]] every two weeks to deliver information, and rumor had it the two were engaged in back-alley dealings.

==Behind the scenes==
The Jawa appears in the article ''[[Secrets of Mos Eisley]]'' in [[2001]]'s [[Star Wars Gamer 7]]''.
